name: bsee-gom-platform-removal-25y
description: Will a newly installed offshore oil and gas structure in federal Gulf of Mexico waters be removed from the Outer Continental Shelf within 25 years of installation?
split_description: Fixed chronological splits by installation date: train 1986-01-01 to 1990-12-31; evaluation 1991-01-01 to 1995-12-31; holdout 1996-01-01 to 2000-12-31. No embargo is needed because each cohort's 25-year outcome window is fully observed and the three windows are disjoint: 2011-2015, 2016-2020, 2021-2025.
